spec.name: sprint32_predmkt_spread_monitor
spec.hypothesis: Kalshi and Polymarket price the same binary event with a cross-venue spread >fees often enough to trade; settlement-definition risk (not price risk) is the main killer, so measure matched-resolution-text spreads before trading.
spec.power_argument: Monitoring phase, not yet a trade spec: need >=300 matched-event-pairs to estimate spread frequency/size before any t-stat trade claim; BLOCKED pending data.py Kalshi+Polymarket loader and a matched-resolution-text signal function (not yet in SIGNALS).
spec.prerequisite: new data.py loader (public APIs, no auth) + new factory.py signal fn; monitor-first per BACKLOG Priority 2 before any trade spec
